svg.title: Closed conditional liquid-bubble-solid model
svg.desc: Laser dose generates a conditional activation and phase inventory. Compressible liquid carries pressure and energy, bubbles exchange mass and heat, gel and film move with traction continuity, and an observer measures the pressure.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
